.github/workflows/autogenerated-automerg:
############################################################
## DO NOT CHANGE - THIS IS AUTOGENERATED BY mahn-ke/repos ##
############################################################

name: Integrate `automerge` branches using rebase
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      pull_request:
        description: Pull request number to update and merge
        required: true
        type: string
  pull_request:
    types: [labeled, unlabeled, synchronize, ready_for_review]
  schedule:
    - cron: '43 * * * *'
  workflow_run:
    workflows:
     - Deploy service, generate certificates, and update NGINX configuration
    types: 
      - completed

jobs:
  automerge:
    if: github.repository != 'mahn-ke/gdqreminder-by-vincent'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - id: automerge
        name: automerge
        uses: "pascalgn/automerge-action@v0.16.4"
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.RENOVATE_TOKEN }}
          PULL_REQUEST: ${{ inputs.pull_request || '' }}
          MERGE_LABELS: "automerge"
          MERGE_READY_STATE: "clean"
          MERGE_METHOD: "rebase"
          UPDATE_METHOD: "rebase"
          UPDATE_RETRIES : 10
          UPDATE_RETRY_SLEEP: 30
          LOG: "TRACE"  # or "DEBUG"

.github/workflows/autogenerated-plan-com:
############################################################
## DO NOT CHANGE - THIS IS AUTOGENERATED BY mahn-ke/repos ##
############################################################

name: Terraform plan image comments

on:
  workflow_run:
    workflows:
      - Deploy service, generate certificates, and update NGINX configuration
    types: [completed]

permissions:
  actions: read
  contents: read
  pull-requests: write

concurrency:
  group: plan-comment-${{ github.event.workflow_run.head_branch }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  comment:
    if: >-
      github.event.workflow_run.event == 'pull_request' &&
      github.event.workflow_run.head_repository.full_name == github.repository
    uses: mahn-ke/.github/.github/workflows/template-plan-comment.yml@main
    with:
      run_id: ${{ format('{0}', github.event.workflow_run.id) }}
      run_attempt: ${{ format('{0}', github.event.workflow_run.run_attempt) }}
    secrets: inherit
.github/workflows/autogenerated-infrastr:
############################################################
## DO NOT CHANGE - THIS IS AUTOGENERATED BY mahn-ke/repos ##
############################################################

name: Infrastructure review policy

on:
  workflow_run:
    workflows:
      - Deploy service, generate certificates, and update NGINX configuration
    types: [requested, completed]
  pull_request_target:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened, edited]
  push:
    branches: [main]
  schedule:
    - cron: '*/15 * * * *'
  workflow_dispatch:

concurrency:
  group: infrastructure-review
  cancel-in-progress: false

permissions:
  contents: write
  pull-requests: read
  checks: write
  actions: read

jobs:
  review:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          repository: mahn-ke/.github
          ref: main
          persist-credentials: false
          path: policy-tools
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version: 24
      - run: node policy-tools/tools/infrastructure-review.mjs
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
